buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) The L1 Bidder will be awarded 60% of the total works. The L2 Bidder should m atch their price with that of L1 Bidder and he will be awarded 40% of the total works. If the L2 Bidder is not willing to match their quoted rate with that of L1

bidder, then L3/L4 /L5 ..., Bidders will be asked to match their quoted price wit h that of L1 Bidder in the order mentioned. If no Bidder is ready to match with that of L1 Bidder’s quoted rate, then 100 % of the works will be awarded to the L1 Bidder or the qualified Bidder of the tender if it turns into single qualified te chnical bid. SCOPE OF WORK Sl. N Activity C SCOPE OF WORK o. ode Collection & loading of lignite Spillage from in and around Unit 1 & 2 Boiler Mill area of NNTPS with contractor's JCB; transport ation of lignite spillage& unloading the same at location instru RMTA CI 1 cted by NLCIL officer using contractor's tractors/tippers within V0817 a lead of 3 KMs from NNTPS. The rate shall also include tools a nd tackles required for the work and hire charges of vehicles e ngaged by the contractor. Collection & loading of lignite Spillage from in and around Unit 1& 2 Boiler Mill area of NNTPS with contractor's workmen and transportation & unloading the same to dumping yard as direc RMTA CI 2 ted by NLCIL officials using contractor's tractors/tippers within V0816 a lead of 3 KMs from NNTPS. The rate shall also include tools a nd tackles required for the work etc. and hire charges of vehicl es engaged by the contractor. Clearing Lignite Spillage in and around Mill area @ 0 M level of Unit 1 & 2 by engaging Skid steer loader (BOB CAT) on hourly RMTH CI basis, collecting and unloading / forming heaps at the place as 3 VS1649 shown by NLCIL officials. The rate shall includes hire charges f or Skid steer loader, All statutory wages for operator and dies el, oil etc., complete required for the work. ***** 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The L1 Bidder will be awarded 60% of the total works. The L2 Bidder should m atch their price with that of L1 Bidder and he will be awarded 40% of the total works. If the L2 Bidder is not willing to match their quoted rate with that of L1 bidder, then L3/L4 /L5 ..., Bidders will be asked to match their quoted price wit h that of L1 Bidder in the order mentioned. If no Bidder is ready to match with that of L1 Bidder’s quoted rate, then 100 % of the works will be awarded to the L1 Bidder or the qualified Bidder of the tender if it turns into single qualified te chnical bid. SPECIAL CONDITIONS Part-I 1.0 The Bidder, before quoting the rate has to positively go around the site of work and understand the

nature & intensity of works involved in all the 16 Mills of Boiler area of Unit I & II of NNTPS. 2.0 The contractor has to mobilize transport facility for movement of Workers & Materials in and around NNTPS, on need basis to carry-out the works quickly without time delay. 3.0 This Contract is for providing Essential Service for the Running Maintenance of Thermal Power Statio n having 2 Units of 500 MW. Hence the resources have to be promptly arranged immediately, as and when required. 4.0 The Contractor Should mobilize 04 JCB's, 02 Bay loader (Bob-Cat) with minimum 03 Tractor with tip pers for Part-I & Part-II separately for both units area cleaning and material shifting. Minimum 13 Wor kmen shall be engaged per shift for Part-I & Part-II separately. 5.0 All the tools tackles, equipments, appliances and all safety gadgets are under the scope of the contr actor. The contractor must also bring all the relevant special tools and tackles, safety appliances etc, in time, for early completion of the work. 6.0 The following safety measures have to be strictly followed while doing works at height. 6.1 All the workers working at height should wear PPEs 6.2 For anchoring the safety belt at height, rigid support and life line should be provided and sa fety belt should always be anchored till the person come to ground level. 6.3 Lone worker should not be permitted to work at height or at confined space. 6.4 Always the work should be carried out under the competent person/supervisor. 6.5 The safety related equipments and accessories should be tested before it is used. 6.6 The work area below should be properly cordoned. 6.7 The healthiness of the person work at height must be checked. 6.8 Fall arrestors must be provided to the workers working at height and they must be in good condition. 7.0 If any exigency arises NLC may extend the contract period and the contractor shall execute the wor k without any increase in rate. 8.0 The work shall be executed as per the scope of work enclosed with the Tender. Daily progress repor t, daily labour report has to be submitted in Triplicate daily to owner. 9.0 The contractor may have to engage labourers on all the days including Sundays & Paid Holidays dur ing the period of contract in First/Second/General shifts as required and as instructed by the Enginee r/Owner. In case of emergency, the Back-hoe loader and manpower shall be engaged in Night Shift al so as per the instructions of NLCIL Executive. 10.0 The contractor or his authorised representative who shall be a qualified supervisor (site supervisor with engineering qualification / BE qualified / Diploma qualified / experienced supervisor) has to sup ervise and co-ordinate with the other divisions for smooth running of the work. He has to prepare all the statutory forms, attendance, EPF, ESI, Bonus calculations for the workers engaged and submit th em for scrutiny. 11.0 Penalty Clause: 11.1 If the contractor fails to carry out the work as directed by NLCIL officers in time, the work wi ll be executed through some other agency and the difference in cost thereof will be recovere d from his bill or any other amount due to be paid to him available with NLC. 11.2 The contractor has to carry out the cleaning continuously by engaging labour on regular ba sis. Any failure in labour engagement resulting in non-cleaning of area scheduled for a partic ular day, NLCIL will levy a penalty of Rs.1,000/- per occasion of non-performance in addition to the proportionate reduction in payment for the area not cleaned. The decision of NLCIL is f inal and binding on this. 11.3 The contractor has to engage minimum 13 unskilled labours per shift for work at the minim um any point of time for cleaning as directed by NLCIL. If the contractor is not engaging the workmen to the minimum i.e. 13 unskilled labours per shift, a penalty of Rs.200/- per man s hift will be levied. Part-II 1.0 SUPERVISOR The contractor should engage a Site supervisor in order to supervise the works a s well as the safety of the workmen. He should report to the officer in-charge bef ore commencement & after completion of work in all shifts every day in every w ork and the work should be done as per instructions from the engineer in-charge and the same should be recorded in the logbook, which is to be attested by the f ield Engineer concerned. The supervisor shall be responsible for coordinating the Entry and Exit of his cre w through the security gate, allocation of work, Supervision of work and safety o

f the workmen. 2.0 SUPERVISOR CHARGES 2.1 Provision are made for supervisor charges in Schedule-II of the tender as detailed below. The c ontract employers shall engage their own supervisors and pay the stipulated monthly wages no t less than supervisory charges mentioned below. TABLE-A Wages to be paid Categor Dearness allowanc Total wages y Rate of wages e-(DA) w.e.f (Rs. per day) 01.10.2026 (Rs. per day) (Rs. per day) Supervi 410.00 251 661 sor 2.2 Also provisions are made towards DA/VDA, EPF, ESI / EC, PH, Bonus, Annual Leave with Wages (ALW), Safety and Ex-Gratia. 2.3 The Contract employer shall remit / pay the statutory components (wherever applicable) Viz., DA/VDA, FPF, ESI / EC, PH, Bonus, Annual Leave with Wages (ALW) and Safety components bas ed on actual attendance of the Supervisors engaged by them. 2.4 The same shall be paid by NLCIL after due verification, subject to the ceiling of the amount pro vided against this in Schedule-II provisions. 2.5 In case, if the specified number of supervisors with requisite qualification / experience is not en gaged by the contractor for the days as per site requirement, then a penalty of 1.5 times of th e supervisory charges specified above shall be deducted from the bills of the contractor. 2.6 The attendance details of the supervisors will be maintained with the signature of the supervis or, countersigned by the contractor as well as the NLCIL official concerned. 2.7 On production of required documents as proof for making payment of wages etc., and remittan ce of Statutory components, the supervisory charges along with statutory & non-statutory provi sion mentioned above will be reimbursed after due verification. 3.0 Tools & tackles, lifting machines & Safety appliances that are used for the work or by the work men should posses ISI mark and valid test certificate from the competent authority. 4.0 The Contractor should observe all safety rules and regulations in force and ensure that all nece ssary safety precautions are followed up strictly for the safety of workers engaged in the work. 5.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of the NLCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. Any extra time / over time engageme nt of the man power shall be the contractor’s responsibility. 6.0 The Schedule-II provisions shall be reimbursed at actuals based on Form-D and Form-B restrict ed to the estimate provisions. 7.0 RATE OF WAGES: The present rates of wages payable to various categories of contract workers are as below: TABLE Wages to be paid Total wages Categor y

Dearness allowanc (Rs. per day) e-(DA) w.e.f Rate of wages 01.10.2026 (Rs. per day) (Rs. per day) USK 350.00 215 565 SSK 410.00 251 661 SK 494.00 300 794 HSK 579.00 354 933 The tender Schedule is bifurcated into two parts Schedule-I & Schedule-II. Sched ule-I contains the total value of work items. The unit rate of each item of works c ontained in the Schedule-I is arrived by adopting the rates of wages as per table above. The bidder shall quote for Schedule-I. “Schedule-II” contains total value of all provisions as detailed below. · PF, ESI & Safety for total wages for the estimate man shift in each category. Also provisions are made towards DA/VDA, PH, Bonus, Annual Leave with Wages (ALW) (if applicable) and E x-Gratia. The same shall be paid by NLCIL after due verification, subject to the ceiling of t he amount provided against this in Schedule-II provisions. The agreement value consists of Schedule-I plus Schedule‑II. 8.0 RATE OF WAGES / DA PAYABLE TO THE WORKMEN & SUPERVISOR The contractor has to pay the rates of wages / DA as per Table above as announ ced by NLCIL and any revision of rates of wages / DA from time to time. Howeve r, in case of any revision of rates of wages / DA notified during contract period, t he contractor shall pay the same along with P.F. & ESI component for the variou s categories of labour component. 9.0 PAYMENT The payment will be made as per the normal terms and conditions of NLCIL and to the extent of work done for Schedule-I. For Schedule-II the payment will be m ade, based on claim the PF (13.00%), ESI (3.25%), Dearness Allowance (DA), PH, ALW (if applicable), Bonus, Ex-Gratia and cost towards the safety appliance ( shall be restricted to the actual expenditure incurred by the Contractor subject t o a maximum of 1.5 % for the total wages payable to the contract workmen / su pervisor) on actual attendance basis (Form-D: Attendance and Form-B: Wage re gister) and without applying tender quoted percentage (without any tender diffe rence (+) or (-)). The same shall be paid by NLCIL after due verification, subject to the ceiling of the amount provided against this in schedule-II provisions. 10.0 RATE REVISION There will be no change in the Schedule -I of agreement. However Contractor shall effect payment and claim the difference in the Statuto

ry rates of wages/DA due to revision along with PF, ESI and Safety @ 17.75 % (i. e 13.00% + 3.25% + 1.5%) of difference in Statutory rates of wages/ DA) by pro ducing Form-D (Attendance Register) and Form-B (Wage register) without tende r difference (+) or (-). 11.0 BONUS The contractor shall ensure payment of minimum bonus of 8.33% of the annual wages to the contrac t workmen & supervisor engaged by them subject to the wages ceiling as provided under Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 and failure in this regard will be treated as violation of the terms of the contract. Payment of minimum bonus of 8.33% of the annual wages to the contract workmen engaged for mor e than 30 days subject to the wages ceiling as provided under payment of bonus act 1965 will be pai d extra by NLC based on the documentary evidence duly scrutinized by NLC. 12.0 PH WAGES If any contract workman & supervisor is employed on a paid holiday declared as such by NLCIL, subj ect to maximum of 9 (nine) days in a year, he shall be paid either double wages (Total wages) (or) s ingle wage (Total wages) plus a compensatory holiday for one day total wages at the discretion of th e workman & supervisor. In case of a contract workmen / supervisor not attending duty on a declare d National and Festival Holiday, he shall be paid single wages subject to fulfillment of the following p rovisions. “No contract workmen shall be entitled to be paid any wages for any of the holiday s (other than the 26th January, the 1st May, the 15th August and the 2nd October) unless he has been in the service under the employer for a total period of 30 days within a continuous period of 90 days immediately preceding such holiday.” NLC will reimburse the one day total wages for each paid holiday for the number of deployed person s on the paid holiday. This is not applicable for the deployment of additional labours / supervisors ap art from regular labours/supervisors for surge works and emergency works if any. 13.0 ANNUAL LEAVE WAGES PAYABLE TO CONTRACT WORKMEN / SUPERVISOR 13.1 The contract workmen / supervisor engaged (by the contractor) for a period of 240 days or mo re during a calendar year shall be allowed Annual Leave with wages during the subsequent cal endar year, for the number of days calculated at the rate of one day for every twenty days of work performed by them during the previous calendar year subject to a maximum of 15 days p er annum. In case a contract worker / supervisor whose service commences otherwise than on the first day of January shall be entitled annual leave with wages at the rate of one day for eve ry twenty days of work performed by him, if he has worked for two-thirds of the total number o f days in the remainder of the calendar year. 13.2 The total amount paid by the contractor as Leave with Wages to the contract workmen / supe rvisor will be reimbursed to the contractor similar to Paid Holiday wages through Schedule-II. 13.3 Based on Form-D (Attendance register), the Contractor Employer shall disburse monthly wag es to the contract workmen & supervisor including the days of Annual Leave with wages grante d to the contract workmen / supervisor concerned and claim the same through part/final bill. 14.0 CONTRACT WORKMEN DEATH RELIEF FUND (CWDF) 14.1 An amount equivalent to 0.2% (zero point two percent) of gross value of every bill payable (b efore statutory, non statutory deductions) shall be deducted towards “Contract Workmen Deat h Relief Fund” (CWDF) from the contractors for the works carried out by the contractor. No pro vision has been made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 14.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contract Workmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/- fr om every contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NL CIL from their salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be ma de from the bills of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & Form -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workman / S upervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / Unit Ac counts Centre. 15.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor s

hall also produce the required age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 16.0 SAFETY Provision of 1.5% of total wages is included in the safety for issuing PPE like Hel met. Safety shoe, Goggles etc in Schedule-II. However claim will be restricted to the actual amount incurred by the contractor towards providing safety equipme nts to the contract workman. 17.0 ESI & EPF 17.1 The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of remitting the co ntribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workman & supervisor engaged by them towards E PF, ESI etc., (as applicable) and NLCIL as the principal employer, will ensure compliance under the relevant applicable statutes by verifying the remittance made by the Contractor Employer s before releasing part / final bills. 17.2 Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI): 17.2.1 In accordance with Paragraph 7 of the Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance Schem e, 1976, the Contractor “where the pay of an employee exceeds fifteen thousand the contribution payable in respect of him by the employer and the Central Government shall be limited to the amounts payable on a monthly pay of fifteen thousand rupees , including dearness allowance, retaining allowance (if any) and cash value of food c oncession”. 17.2.2 In view of the above that the contractor shall remit EDLI contribution @ 0.5% limited to monthly pay of Rs.25,000/-. 17.3 NLCIL shall reimburse the EDLI contributions based on the amount limited to monthly pay of R s.25,000/- @ 0.5%. 18.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Not Applicable. 19.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY Not Applicable 20.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable 21.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT The Period of contract for this work is “11 (eleven) months from service start dat e as per GeM contract.” Note: Lead days of 3 days are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilizati on for offering service. Thus the service start date will commence from minimu m 3 days after contract generation date. 22.0 PAYMENT TERMS The payment will be made against the completion of work on “pro-rata basis”. Bi lls duly prepared based on the item rates agreed in the contract, shall be submit ted to the NLCIL Officer in charge after the satisfactory completion of the job. Th e first Running Account bill will be released only after signing of contract by the Contractor and the payment will be released after the acceptance of invoice wit hin 30 days. The final bill will be passed only after producing valid No-Due certifi

cate from T.A by the Contractor and The final bill will be paid only after the finali zation of the contract". 23.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence. Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules. 24.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances . ***** . 3.
